gems.title: 安昂传奇：最后的气宗
gems.summary: 派拉蒙和尼克宣布“降世神通”系列开发三部新的电影，仍是动画形式。第一部由《降世神通：最后的气宗》导演Lauren Montgomery执导，《最后的气宗》主创Bryan Konietzko和Michael DiMartino担任制片人。
gems.summaryEn: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls i
gems.whyWatch: 气宗回归，动画史诗再续新章。
gems.whyWatchEn: The Avatar universe returns with a promising animated trilogy, reigniting the magic of elemental bending.
gems.audience: 动画爱好者、降世神通粉丝、奇幻冒险迷
gems.audienceEn: Animation lovers, Avatar franchise fans, fantasy and adventure enthusiasts

gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。

gems.whyWatch: 奥德修斯的归乡之旅，史诗再临银幕。
gems.whyWatchEn: A fresh cinematic take on Homer's epic journey, blending myth with high-stakes adventure.
gems.audience: 古希腊神话爱好者、史诗冒险片观众、历史奇幻粉丝
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Greek mythology, epic adventure seekers, historical fantasy enthusiasts
